build._comment_dockerfilePath: Not the root Dockerfile — that one is shaped for Hugging Face Spaces (UID 1000, port 7860, embedder baked after USER). deployment/Dockerfile.backend is the platform-neutral multi-stage build and is what belongs here.

deploy._comment_healthcheckPath: /health/live, deliberately NOT /health/ready. Readiness answers 503 when any dependency layer is down, which is information you want on a dashboard but not wired to a restart loop — a cold Chroma would crash-loop the deploy.
deploy._comment_replicas: One replica, deliberately. pipeline.py:58 keeps results in a process-local dict, so a second replica 404s /api/result/{id} for whichever half of requests lands on the wrong one.
